title: Machine learning-guided multimodal analysis of APAF1-associated tumor microenvironment features prioritizes morellic acid for gastric cancer.
publicationName: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
journalName: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
snippet: Gastric cancer (GC) exhibits substantial molecular heterogeneity and a complex tumor microenvironment (TME). Apoptotic protease-activating factor 1 (APAF1) is a core component of mitochondrial apoptosis; however, its association with immune characteristics, spatial heterogeneity and compound discovery in GC remains poorly defined.
